questions.text: Which band released the debut album 'Parachutes' in the year 2000?
questions.explanation: Coldplay's first album, 'Parachutes', was released in July 2000.

questions.text: In 2004, which animated film featured a soundtrack that included the song 'Accidentally in Love' by Counting Crows?
questions.explanation: 'Accidentally in Love' was the lead single from the soundtrack of Shrek 2.

questions.text: In which fictional city is the 2004 film 'The Incredibles' primarily set?
questions.explanation: Metroville is the primary setting of Pixar's 'The Incredibles', a fictional city distinct from other comic-book cities.
